description: Tests the connection to a data sink destination by writing a small test object under the configured prefix, then deleting it. Give a saved data sink ID to test its stored destination, optionally with an S3 draft to test unsaved edits. A draft supplies the bucket, region, access key ID and prefix; an empty prefix clears the stored prefix. Omit or leave the draft secret empty to reuse the saved secret. Without an ID, supply a complete destination and secret. Checks never save configuration changes. A successful check does not prove multipart upload or SSE-KMS permissions.

cleanupError.description: Why the test object could not be deleted, when it could not.
cleanupError.title: cleanupError

dataSinkID.description: The saved data sink used as the default destination and credential source for the check.
dataSinkID.title: dataSinkID

s3.description: The S3 draft to test instead of the stored destination. Supply the bucket, region and access key ID; an empty or omitted prefix means the bucket root. With dataSinkID, an empty or omitted secret keeps the stored secret. Without dataSinkID, the secret is required. The draft is never saved.
s3.title: s3

status.description: Succeeded when the object was written and deleted. WriteFailed when it could not be written. CleanupFailed when it was written but could not be deleted: the destination is usable, but remove the test object.
status.title: status

testKey.description: The key of the test object.
testKey.title: testKey

type.description: The type of the unsaved destination.
type.title: type

title: DataSinkCheck
